title: The DADO showroom opens the new season with a refreshed display
excerpt: Our Tashkent showroom now presents all core formats of ROMA, ITALICA and GRESART in a new layout. Every collection can be seen in a setting close to a real interior.
body:
Spring marks the start of the renovation and construction season. To meet it, the DADO showroom welcomes clients with a refreshed display. In the hall at 56A Abdulla Qahhor Street, our three brands, ROMA, ITALICA and GRESART, are now presented in separate zones.

The main idea of the new layout is to see tiles on a wall and a floor rather than in a catalogue. For every collection, samples in 300×300, 300×600, 600×600 and 600×1200 are laid over large surfaces, so pattern repetition and joint appearance can be judged accurately.

The ROMA zone gathers marble and natural-stone textures in a warm palette. The ITALICA section is dedicated to large formats with concrete, terrazzo and wood looks. The GRESART area shows decorative and relief surfaces in bold colours.

In the showroom, our specialists help you choose the format, surface type and laying pattern for your project. If needed, samples can be taken to the site and compared under real lighting.

The showroom is open Monday to Saturday, 09:00–19:00. We recommend arranging a visit in advance on +998 78 150 00 02 so the collections you need are prepared for your arrival.
